overall.method: the weighted mean of the scored components, the weights renormalized over those scored; published only when both manifestUptime and paywallUptime are scored

manifestUptime.method: each pass records the seller's newest crawl, if newer than the last one recorded: 1 when its own documents answered with routes, 0 when the seller's host answered with an error or nothing usable; a read that failed on our side (our time limit, resolver or size limit), a robots.txt exclusion and a registry-only record are left out

paywallUptime.method: each pass records the newest unpaid probe of the seller's cheapest paid route, if newer than the last one recorded: 1 when it answered 402, 0 for any other status; a probe that read no status or a malformed-request answer (400, 415, 422) is left out

responsiveness.method: time from our unpaid paywall probe to the seller's response headers, measured from this server; the score is the share of probes answered within 2000 ms, beside the median

priceMatchesListing.method: routes whose 402 we read live in the window and whose own documents list a price: the share where the price the 402 asks matches the listed price

delivery.method: measured from purchases Agent402's router made for buyers: 1 when the seller answered 200 after taking the payment, 0 when the router recorded a delivery failure (a 5xx after payment, or a 4xx the seller or the chain shows was charged); a caller's own input error, and calls made for our own probes, canaries and wallets, are left out
delivery.label: measured from purchases Agent402's router made for buyers

age.note: when this record first saw the seller in the index; a seller listed before recordsSince reads that date
